summaryZh: Gallo 实验室研究皮肤及其常驻微生物组如何抵御感染和环境影响。团队结合生物化学、免疫学、微生物学与遗传学研究免疫系统和微生物组，旨在发展诊断与治疗。
researchQuestions: 皮肤及其常驻微生物组如何保护机体抵御感染和环境影响？

evidence.quote: Our research is focused on understanding how the skin and its resident microbiome defends the body against infections and the environment. We apply modern techniques of biochemistry, immunology, microbiology, and genetics to study complex biological systems within the immune system and the microbiome.
